about: A radiant-cut centre is suspended between two flat, architectural bands that never meet — an open-shank design finished with a matte surface and polished edges.
why_this_works: The split shank draws the eye straight to the centre stone and makes a large radiant feel weightless on the hand. The matte-and-polish contrast keeps a big diamond from tipping into showiness.
wedding_band_fit: Requires a bespoke band shaped to the open shank.

specifications.wedding_band_fit: Requires a bespoke band shaped to the open shank.
